fonts.display: 'Recoleta', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Lota Grotes Que Alt', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cream Paper
palette.role: Page background, canvas — warm off-white that softens the overall feel and keeps the pastel accents from vibrating against pure white

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card and button surfaces — sits one elevation above the cream canvas

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes, card outlines — the dominant structural color, 3625 occurrences make it the spine of every layout

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Body text and secondary headings when a slightly softer black is needed

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Nav text and subdued UI labels

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Subtle link underlines and dividers in muted contexts

palette.name: Mint Splash
palette.role: Primary action button fill, hand-drawn headline highlight swashes, active nav emphasis — the signature color that signals go

palette.name: Plum Ink
palette.role: Deep brand accent for dark surface text, illustration fills, and emphasis — provides a rich counterweight to the pastels

palette.name: Aubergine
palette.role: Outlined action border, dark button outline variant — borders and strokes when a deeper violet frame is needed without filling

palette.name: Sky Pop
palette.role: Decorative illustration strokes, confetti dots, secondary accent chips, icon outlines — the cool member of the pastel set

palette.name: Bubblegum
palette.role: Decorative confetti dots, highlight swashes, playful accent shapes — adds warmth and energy

palette.name: Peach Pop
palette.role: Decorative dots, warm accent fills, illustration warm tones — the sunset note in the pastel quartet
